name: Visual Genome: Connecting Language and Vision
description: Visual Genome is an extensive multimodal knowledge dataset created to advance visual understanding from individual pixels to structured semantics. It contains 108,077 images richly annotated with 5.4 million region descriptions, 1.7 million visual question-answer pairs, 3.8 million object instances, 2.8 million attributes, and 2.3 million visual relationships mapped into unified scene graphs and WordNet synsets.

citation.paper_title: Visual Genome: Connecting Language and Vision Using Crowdsourced Dense Image Annotations

provenance.collection_method: 108,077 images sourced from MS COCO and YFCC100M, annotated across 33,000 hours of Amazon Mechanical Turk human work.
provenance.curation_notes: Objects, attributes, and relationships canonicalized to WordNet synsets to ensure consistent semantic ontology.
